mapper.insert: insert into analysis_history ( input_url, video_id, title, category_name_ko, duration_seconds, is_short_form, blocked_by_category, has_violence, violence_score, violence_positive_windows, has_nudity, nudity_match_count, harmful, harmful_reasons_json, status, error_message, created_at ) values ( #{inputUrl}, #{videoId}, #{title}, #{categoryNameKo}, #{durationSeconds}, #{shortForm}, #{blockedByCategory}, #{hasViolence}, #{violenceScore}, #{violencePositiveWindows}, #{hasNudity}, #{nudityMatchCount}, #{harmful}, #{harmfulReasonsJson}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: select analysis_id as analysis_id, input_url as input_url, video_id as video_id, title as title, category_name_ko as category_name_ko, duration_seconds as duration_seconds, is_short_form as is_short_form, blocked_by_category as blocked_by_category, has_violence as has_violence, violence_score as violence_score, violence_positive_windows as violence_positive_windows, has_nudity as has_nudity, nudity_match_count as nudity_match_count, harmful as harmful, harmful_reasons_json as harmful_reasons_json, status as status, error_message as error_message, created_at as created_at from analysis_history order by created_at desc, analysis_id desc limit #{limit}
